title: Error Messages Omnipod Dash
body:
I installed the AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-b on Sunday and now have the following error messages:
1. Setting temp basal might have basal failed if temp basal was previously runnig, it was canceled. pleas manually refresh pod status from the omnipod tab.
2. Unable to verify whether SMB bolus (0.35U) succeeded. <b>Refresh pod status to confirm or deny this command.
3. AndroidAPS not responding:
            close the app
            waiting
Since the messages appear more frequently, I believe that a correction should be made. Many Thanks.
Lothar
My systems: Pixel 4a, Byoda, xDrip
